title: Corvette ZR1 vs Ferrari 296 GTB: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Two rear-engine supercars, both with twin turbochargers, both with eight-speed dual-clutch gearboxes, both rear-wheel drive. One has a five point five litre V eight and one thousand, sixty-four horsepower. The other has a three litre V six, an electric motor, and a prancing horse on the nose. In a drag race filmed in December, the cheaper one won both runs. This is the real difference between the Corvette ZR1 and the Ferrari two ninety-six G T B. Here is the twist. In the drag race, the Corvette won by about four tenths of a second. But the race was a single video with no stated conditions, the Ferrari makes a very different kind of car, and the price gap, on the figures we found, is much larger than the headlines suggest. We will go through the numbers, and say where the sources disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
